messages:
alex: Quick sync — trying to lock the network consent matrix and launch slices for Private (VPC/on‑prem). Need field input on what we'll require vs optional at GA. TL;DR: customers keep asking to opt into customer‑managed egress IPs and bring‑your‑own-peering; do we gate these behind later launch slices?
priya: Agree we need a matrix. My take: GA must support basic customer‑managed networking (static egress IP, DNS override). Peering and advanced multi‑tenant routing can be v1.1.
mateo: From eng-runtime POV the biggest risk is supporting BYO BGP/peering at GA — it complicates installer and operator surfaces. Can we offer a managed relay fallback for GA?
jun: +1 on managed relay fallback. Field told me large customers want a path that preserves egress IPs for firewall whitelisting during cutover. Relay solves that for early adopters.
lina: Customer ask: ability to approve network changes via a consent toggle in the installer UI, not just in YAML. They want audit trail and explicit opt‑in per cluster.
carla: For deliveries team, we need clear launch slices: 1) Private GA (installer, static egress IP, DNS override, KMS integr.), 2) Field slice (managed relay + consent toggle + audit logs), 3) Advanced NetOps (peering, BGP, multi‑tenant routing). Can we commit to that?
mateo: That sequencing feels achievable. Promises for each slice: engineering effort estimates — GA 3 sprints, Field slice 2 sprints, Advanced NetOps 4+ sprints. Dependencies: installer refactor and identity handshake.
alex: Good. Can someone sketch the consent matrix rows/cols? I started a tiny table in Notion: https://notion.so/rw-network-consent (placeholder). We need minimal required vs opt‑in flags and expected signals to roll back.
priya: Quick proposal (paste):
```
features: [static_egress_ip, dns_override, consent_toggle_ui, audit_logs, managed_relay, peering_bgp]
GA: [static_egress_ip, dns_override]
Field: [consent_toggle_ui, audit_logs, managed_relay]
Advanced: [peering_bgp]
```
Notes: consent_toggle ties to operator role and emits audit event.
jun: Ops note: consent_toggle must be enforced server‑side (control plane) and not just local UI flag. Otherwise it won't satisfy compliance customers.
carla: Also need rollout gates per customer: small pilot (10 customers) -> expanded pilot (50) -> general availability. Each gate needs postmortem and risk checklist.
mateo: Engineer ask: add a fallback policy that automatically routes to hosted endpoints if connectivity checks fail for >30s during requests. That reduces downtime risk for peering edge cases.
lina: UX: suggest a two‑step consent flow in UI + email confirmation for critical network changes. Keeps legal happy.
alex: Action items: 1) Mateo: enumerate infra changes and blocker list for GA (due EOD Tue). 2) Priya: update notion consent matrix with the YAML snippet and customer examples (due Wed). 3) Jun: draft pilot gating checklist and rollback playbook (due Fri). 4) Carla: align field comms and pilot customer list (due Fri).
carla: I'll reach out to acme/netops and get tentative pilot greenlight today.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: private-installer-refactor -> canary at 2026-04-01T02:00Z (info) :rocket:
ops-bot: incident-tracker: flagged risk "peering-bgp-unverified" for advanced slice. Will auto-create runbook if pilot expands.
alex: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate and share a short one‑pager for execs. Please update the notion page so we can attach it to the roadmap PR. :thumbsup:
priya: added initial matrix and examples. Linking: https://notion.so/rw-network-consent#matrix (placeholder)
mateo: file upload: small diff for installer checks -> see gist: https://gist.github.com/mateo/installer-checks (placeholder)
jun: Optional: include test harness for synthetic network interruptions during upgrade path. Will pair with eng‑sre next week.
alex: Last call: any objections to the slices and owners? If no objections by EOD, we'll lock and update roadmap.
lina: no objections from UX.
carla: no objections.
priya: no objections.
mateo: no objections.
jun: no objections.
carla: re: pilot customers — I'll post names in the pilot thread once confirmed."
